autosubmit_or_autoroute_note: The route does not auto-submit or auto-reroute merely because a suggestion is highlighted, read, or temporarily explored.

combobox_controls.recovery_note: The voter can dismiss the popup, revise the text, or clear the field without losing the prior county context.
combobox_controls.result_change_note: After a committed selection, the page updates the county office details region and announces the new county in a bounded status message.
combobox_controls.typed_text_without_selection_note: Typing narrows suggestions but does not itself change the active county until a specific option is chosen and submitted.

combobox_surface_label: Example combobox/suggestion-popup posture for an official voter-information route
compact_mobile_note: Compact/mobile layouts preserve the label, commit boundary, and recovery path when the popup covers surrounding page context.
delivery_role_note: Bounded suggestion-control surface for official voter-information routes that use a combobox or searchable selector to choose from an answer-bearing official set.
help_or_overview_escape_note: Where the searchable selector alone may not resolve the case, a visible overview/help lane remains available instead of forcing trial-and-error suggestion picking.
manual_revision_or_escape_note: The voter can revise text, dismiss the popup, and back out of an explored suggestion without restarting the route or guessing whether a hidden option remains active.
multiple_combobox_disambiguation_note: Where more than one combobox appears on a page, each one has a distinct label and purpose so users can tell which official set it controls.
result_update_announcement_note: Meaningful answer-lane changes after a committed selection are announced in bounded form without interrupting ordinary exploration.
selected_option_visibility_note: Once committed, the chosen official option remains visible enough that the voter can review which county, office, or article set currently controls the answer lane.
selection_commit_boundary_note: The route distinguishes typed text, highlighted suggestions, and committed selected options so a voter can tell when the official answer lane has actually changed.
